verdicts.reason: A: the flavour list is out of its original order, tiny and has ragged, misaligned bullets; the CTA is a minuscule pill stranded bottom-left; the can is jammed against the right and top edges; and the large dead area on the left makes it lopsided. B: the headline is wrapped into a cramped three-line stack next to the logo, and 'Cola Crash' is split off from its list to sit alone beside the CTA. Still, B fills the strip left to right with readable text, a strong CTA and a well-sized can, so it's the less bad of the two.
